title: Data Center Federal Legal Spine 2025–2026
question: Which federal legal objects actually govern U.S. data-center buildout, and which proposed, issued, authorized, constructed and operating states remain separate?
bluf: No enacted general federal commercial data-center moratorium, large-load queue, rate-allocation mandate, water-reporting regime, emissions fee or federal-land prohibition was found. EO 14318 implementation has produced real but decentralized solicitations, selections, leases, permitting objects and guidance that do not collapse into a completed project or blanket exemption.
